worldcombat.skill.swallow.summary: Swallow the stored power as healing: more layers restore more, three layers can heal you fully, and swallowing consumes all of it — including the Defence and Special Defence the charge had granted.
worldcombat.skill.swallow.use.0: Bank three layers of Stockpile and cash them in for the biggest heal
worldcombat.skill.swallow.use.1: Cash your layers into healing while being chased
worldcombat.skill.swallow.use.2: Sip it in small mouthfuls to waste less on overheal
worldcombat.skill.swallow.description.0: Swallow the stored power: restore %1$s of max HP based on the layers held, consuming all of it; with nothing stored it cannot be used.
worldcombat.skill.swallow.description.1: The digest window is a base %1$s: Sipping lands the three mouthfuls across it so each can cover damage taken meanwhile, while a single gulp leaves only a brief mark.
worldcombat.skill.swallow.description.2: Telegraph %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.swallow.sip.on: Sipping: the heal comes in three mouthfuls at x0.9 total, but cooldown is 15 shorter and small mouthfuls cover damage taken meanwhile.
worldcombat.skill.swallow.sip.off: One gulp: the whole heal lands at once with the written cooldown; at full HP the excess spills over.
worldcombat.skill.swallow.timing: The telegraph can be interrupted without paying anything; PP and cooldown settle only after commit.
worldcombat.skill.swallow.preference.sip: On: the heal comes in three mouthfuls at x0.9 total with 15 shorter cooldown, covering damage taken meanwhile. Off: one gulp of the full amount, longer cooldown, spills over at full HP.
The companion swallows once its HP falls below this ratio; lower hoards longer, higher cashes out sooner.
How many layers to bank before swallowing; three heals completely, and the default of two matches Stockpile's own default hoard.
On: below the cash-out ratio, swallow even a single layer to survive. Off: do not swallow under the minimum layers and keep banking.
worldcombat.skill.swallow.description.la: The heal depends on the layers actually held when swallowed: each layer restores 18%%-32%% of max HP based on Special Defence and weight, and a full three layers adds another step, up to a full heal; it never exceeds the health you are missing. Swallowing also takes back the Defence and Special Defence the charge granted.
